about: Uniform presets (design-interview Q61): Uniforms whose meaning Grape knows. A Uniform declaration points to one by `entry`; its name and type come from here and are locked in the web editor. `expression` is what TD writes on the row when it is created (TD reads it from the editor bundle, never from a request). `common` is the common identity (common_sources.json). Edit this file only; build:core generates src/core-ts/uniform_presets.ts and puts the table in editor-bootstrap.json.

presets.name: uAbsTime
presets.hint: Seconds since TouchDesigner started; keeps running.

presets.name: uAbsFrame
presets.hint: Frames since TouchDesigner started; keeps running.

presets.name: uTime
presets.hint: Seconds on this Grape OP's timeline; stops and loops with the timeline. For time that keeps running, use uAbsTime.

presets.name: uFrame
presets.hint: Frame on this Grape OP's timeline; stops and loops with the timeline.

presets.name: uDeltaTime
presets.hint: Seconds from the previous frame to this one (all of TouchDesigner).

presets.name: uFrameStep
presets.hint: Frames from the previous frame to this one; more than 1 when TouchDesigner drops frames.
